{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check distribution of gender
print(df['sex'].value_counts())

# Check distribution of treatment arm
print(df['arm'].value_counts())

# Check if gender and treatment arm are balanced
# Cross-tabulate gender vs arm
crosstab_gender_arm = pd.crosstab(df['sex'], df['arm'])
print(crosstab_gender_arm)

# Check if gender and severity are balanced
crosstab_gender_severity = pd.crosstab(df['sex'], df['severity'])
print(crosstab_gender_severity)"}
